    |   `-- history: CanvasHistoryRecord
    |-- apply / undo / redo / reset
    |   |-- reconstruct controller using history + injected service
    |   |-- use the same coordinator as live editing
    |   |-- export history + proposed state + exact nodeOrigins
    |   |-- refresh changes; status becomes draft
    |   `-- persist through DiagramChangeSessionStore
    |-- older documents without history
    |   `-- import available past/proposed/future states on mutation
    |       `-- canonical history replaces legacy state stacks
    `-- browser ChangeSessionPreview
        `-- separate controller using browser DiagramService
            |-- fresh context from cloned proposed document
            |-- does not import proposal history
            `-- expanded initial layout; folds remain viewer-local
